Introducing Saved Views, now available today across all paid plans. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters, sort order, or grouping every time you open a project, this one's for you. Saved Views let you capture exactly how you like to see your work — filtered by assignee, sorted by due date, grouped by status, or any combination you rely on — and return to it instantly, without reconfiguring anything.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so whether you're tracking a single sprint or managing work across dozens of projects, you'll have room to organize things your way. Need your team on the same page? Any view can be shared, giving everyone instant access to the same filtered perspective instead of repeating setup steps or hunting through settings.

Saved Views work across boards, lists, and timelines, and update automatically as your data changes, so what you see is always current. This is a small change that saves real time every single day.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
